opening.argument: The video presents Drop as an ordinary rewards program: users download the app, link eligible cards, and continue using them normally to accumulate points. The narration explains that "the more cards you link, the more points you're going to be able to rack up," describing routine participation rather than an investment or guaranteed financial return. The Starbucks feature is shown as a points-based redemption, with "5,000 points equals $5" and a gift card provided after redemption. The Hulu example is likewise described as another in-app rewards example. These are promotional instructions for earning and redeeming loyalty benefits through ordinary purchases, not a promise of profit or an outcome beyond the stated rewards.
